[[File:Probe_droid_desk_toy.png|thumb|Probe Droid Desk Toy]]
'''Probe Droid Desk Toys''' were novelty items meant for the work force or other places and methods involving desks that, as the name suggested, resembled the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

[[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] procured one such toy after retrieving one of the real deals as part of a mission for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and added it to his collection.

*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''
